g.text: Fixed waveform example: anchor-08, phase 0, norm 0.016, dt 0.005
First eligible upper-margin anchor in the frozen order; all three neuron outputs and the full 300-time-unit records.
These traces use the original time origin. The utility statistic separately permits one constant phase offset, without frequency fitting.
